items.title: Jensen Huang exit odds are low on prediction markets after Nvidia probe
items.summary: Nvidia 's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang , citing recent reports that he's been targeted by a "foreign intelligence effort," but traders on prediction markets think it's unlikely he'll be ousted as chief.

items.title: Goldman CEO Solomon says AI financing remains strong despite market jitters
items.summary: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon told CNBC on Monday that financing demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure remains strong despite recent market jitters as investors reassess the risks involving the massive build-out.

items.title: China exports, imports soar past expectations in October — surplus narrows sharply
items.summary: China's exports and imports surged more than expected in October, while its surplus shrank sharply, undershooting expectations even as it crossed $1 trillion for the year so far.

items.title: 3 unexpected reasons the October jobs report was so strong
items.summary: A little-noticed category in Friday's blockbuster jobs report is challenging the consensus view about job losses caused by artificial intelligence.

items.title: A key report for where inflation stood in October comes out Tuesday. Here's what to expect
items.summary: Falling gasoline prices provided some relief to consumers in October, but Federal Reserve officials are increasingly concerned that inflation pressures elsewhere in the economy are proving harder to contain.
